content: {"doneWhen":{"all":[{"path":"body.x","op":"eq","value":11},{"path":"body.y","op":"eq","value":1}]},"modes":[{"id":"fight","priority":10,"when":{"all":[{"path":"nearest(monster).dist","op":"lte","value":1}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"fight"}},{"id":"flee","priority":9,"when":{"all":[{"path":"nearest(monster).dist","op":"lte","value":2}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"flee"}},{"id":"navigate","priority":1,"when":{"all":[{"path":"body.x","op":"gte","value":0}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"go-to-ladder"}}],"skills":[{"name":"fight","skill":"async (b) => { const p = await b.body(); const ms = await b.monsters(); let best = null, bd = 1e9; for (const m of ms) { const d = Math.abs(m.x-p.x)+Math.abs(m.y-p.y); if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = m; } } if (!best) return; await b.faceAndPress(best.x, best.y, 'ControllerX', 0); b.log('swing at ' + best.x + ',' + best.y); }","check":"async (b) => ({ok: true, detail: 'swung'})"},{"name":"flee","skill":"async (b) => { const p = await b.body(); const ms = await b.monsters(); let best = null, bd = 1e9; for (const m of ms) { const d = Math.abs(m.x-p.x)+Math.abs(m.y-p.y); if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = m; } } if (!best) return; const dx = p.x - best.x, dy = p.y - best.y; let tx = p.x, ty = p.y; if (Math.abs(dx) >= Math.abs(dy)) tx += dx >= 0 ? 1 : -1; else ty += dy >= 0 ? 1 : -1; tx = Math.max(0, Math.min(12, tx)); ty = Math.max(0, Math.min(9, ty)); const r = await b.walkTo(tx, ty, 'stand'); b.log('flee to ' + tx + ',' + ty + ': ' + JSON.stringify(r)); }","check":"async (b) => ({ok: true, detail: 'fled'})"},{"name":"go-to-ladder","skill":"async (b) => { const r = await b.walkTo(11, 1, 'stand'); b.log('walkTo ladder: ' + JSON.stringify(r)); if (!r.ok) { const r2 = await b.walkTo(11, 1, 'adjacent'); b.log('adjacent fallback: ' + JSON.stringify(r2)); } }","check":"async (b) => { const p = await b.body(); return {ok: p.x === 11 && p.y === 1, detail: 'at ' + p.x + ',' + p.y}; }"}]}
